next_action.instruction: Use the Current A1 circulation exit path as a learner: closed-book System Recall -> browser-global full-paper holdout -> enter the remaining circulation System sweep -> verify fast-pass and Wrong/Uncertain handling -> export a real W/U packet to Chat -> finish with a short System Recall. Do not add another learning feature merely because A1 scope now exists.
next_action.success_condition: A1 expands to exactly 376 Current Question Truth IDs, the browser-global holdout removes its stored full-paper years before consumption, no respiratory-specific presentation leaks into A1, and Wrong/Uncertain evidence reaches Chat without guessed Question-to-KP mapping.
next_action.validation_note: A1 membership has been deterministically re-audited against historical source-coverage/taxonomy evidence and later HLK owner-range evidence. This branch runs a full Astro build before the transition is fast-forwarded to main; real learner use remains the stronger interaction-level evidence.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not add more learning-stage taxonomies merely for completeness.
Do not turn KianOS into a second Lecture or require duplicate long-form reading.
Do not equate MI-D with Precision or turn Precision into a separate first-pass drill queue.
Do not put Connection Hooks into ordinary Memory or turn Reserve Learning into a second course.

Do not rebuild the restored A1 circulation 376-question or A2 respiratory 359-question System scopes by model inference; both are deterministic Current identifier scopes and Runtime must fail closed on count/hash/Question Truth mismatch.
Do not infer Question-to-Block/KP mappings from title similarity, page proximity, System membership, source section, or model intuition.
Do not treat System-level question membership as the same authority as the explicit Chat-reviewed Question-to-Knowledge relation owner.
Do not persist learner-specific full-paper holdout year values in shared Current; holdout is private browser-global learner state and every System sweep must respect the stored years.

Do not recover urinary System question scope merely for completeness; use the same deterministic evidence standard that was required for A1/A2 and do not infer membership from titles or model intuition.
Do not optimize for more UI controls, cards, metadata, or governance files without observed learning benefit.
Do not use legacy repository content as normal Current authority. The bounded respiratory historical recovery exception is closed.
after_validation: If A1/A2 System Exit remains good in real use and the urinary historical evidence can meet the same deterministic standard, re-audit A3 urinary next rather than re-reviewing its questions from scratch.
Only deepen Question-to-Block/KP relations for Wrong/Uncertain or otherwise high-value questions unless second-round strategy provides new evidence.
Preserve the frozen first-pass -> second-pass -> late-review stage responsibilities and System-level true-question strategy from study-policy.json.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update this file only at meaningful shared-work stage transitions or when the next shared Xizong action changes materially.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, study-policy.json, and only the Current owners needed by next_action. Continue from next_action instead of reconstructing the roadmap from legacy chats.
